user_directive.summary: For listed-company announcements, major finance portals including but not limited to Sina Finance, Tencent Finance, Tonghuashun, Xueqiu and Eastmoney are approved authoritative data sources when they preserve the formal announcement or original document.
interpretation: The policy applies to formal listed-company announcements, statutory filings, periodic reports and announcement attachments, not to every article hosted by the same portal.
A portal copy of the formal announcement can be authoritative redistribution rather than ordinary secondary reporting.
The list of finance portals is illustrative rather than a hard-coded domain allowlist.

method_decision.claim_scope_requirement: The archived payload must preserve or reliably map the same formal upstream announcement/filing claim; summaries, extracted quote pages and editorial rewrites remain secondary according to their actual content.
provenance_contract: Preserve the actual retrieval host and retrieval URL.

Preserve upstream announcement identity separately: issuer, regulator/exchange system where known, announcement/filing/accession identifier, title, original URL and source-supported publication/known-time metadata where available.
Never record bytes obtained from a finance portal as if they were directly retrieved from the regulator or issuer server.
Multiple redistributors carrying the same upstream announcement are one evidence cluster, not independent corroboration.
method_decision.storage_compatibility: Legacy memory-audit disposition names PRIMARY_SUPPORTS_LEAD / PRIMARY_CONTRADICTS_LEAD remain unchanged for compatibility; generalized authoritative reason codes now cover authoritative redistributors.

bounded_source_discovery.conclusion: Approved finance portals are a viable authoritative acquisition family, but the exact Livent Q1 2019 target payload URLs/bytes were not recovered in this bounded search.

positive_capability_evidence.observation: Tonghuashun US filing mirror exposes an SEC EX-99.1 document body and preserves filing/exhibit structure; this example references FMC Lithium/Livent separation history.
Tonghuashun filing mirror explicitly identifies a filing submitted by Livent Corporation and the SEC file number, demonstrating upstream filing identity can survive redistribution.
